title: From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
task: Vision-language-action policy learning for robot manipulation
key_results: NEO-VLA outperforms encoder-based VLAs; achieves 93 vs 84 successes in 100 trials on unseen tablecloth/lighting vs teleoperated baseline
comments: Encoder-free architecture is conceptually simple but the consistent gap persists even with full fine-tuning, suggesting fundamental architectural benefits for embodied control.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Action policies benefit from direct access to intermediate visual representations rather than fixed encoder output
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; layer-wise probing shows action-critical signals peak before final representation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Native architectures outperform encoder-based counterparts under controlled comparisons
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; gap persists with full fine-tuning and additional scale

title: GameVerse: A Minute-Scale Gameplay Dataset for Long-Horizon Interactive World Modeling
task: Long-horizon interactive world modeling dataset creation
key_results: GameVerse: 69.7K clips, 1,655 hours, 349.6M frames; 1,358 hours of continuous two-minute sequences (order of magnitude longer than prior datasets)
comments: The dataset design addresses a real bottleneck in interactive world models—lack of long-horizon training data rather than model capacity limitations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Training on minute-scale videos extends temporal coherence of interactive world models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; substantial extension of temporal horizon demonstrated

title: Turns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit
task: Streaming video RL with turn-level credit assignment
key_results: TurnWise improves over trajectory-level RL baselines on streaming video understanding; reduces redundant replies and encourages informative follow-ups
comments: The turn-level credit assignment elegantly addresses a mismatch between feedback granularity and interaction structure in streaming settings.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Turn-level credit assignment aligns better with streaming decisions than trajectory-level feedback
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms prior RL approaches without learned critic or additional rollouts

title: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
task: End-to-end physics research evaluation for AI agents
key_results: FrontierPhysics: 56 tasks from 42 physicists across 9 domains; no configuration passes >46/168 rollouts; main weaknesses are insufficiently rigorous reasoning and limited expert intuition
comments: The benchmark reveals that frontier research requires more than physics knowledge—it needs reasoning rigor and domain intuition that current agents lack.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agents can conduct publishable physics research when evaluated on frontier problems
hypotheses.result: Mostly rejected; max 46/168 rollouts passed; gaps in reasoning rigor and expert intuition identified

title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
task: Understanding multi-turn agentic RL performance under interaction constraints
key_results: RL advantages diminish significantly with tight budgets; BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings without budget dependence
comments: Reveals that agentic RL strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience rather than improving single-step decisions uniformly.

model_io.model: BudgetMix RL (agentic RL with variable budgets)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via Pass@(K,T) evaluation; advantages diminish with budget constraints

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agentic RL uniformly improves single-step decision quality
hypotheses.result: Rejected; strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience

title: EmoReward: Self-Evolving Reward Calibration for Emotional Video Generation RL
task: Self-evolving reward calibration for emotional video generation
key_results: EmoReward improves emotional video generation on HunyuanVideo 1.5; adaptive reward calibration outperforms fixed reward weights across multiple RL algorithms
comments: The self-evolving mechanism elegantly addresses the challenge of reward design for subjective aesthetic tasks by learning which signals to trust during training.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Self-evolving reward calibration improves emotional video generation over fixed reward weights
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; improvements on HunyuanVideo 1.5 and transfer to SD 3.5, FLUX

title: PyRUA-DataFarm: LLM Agent as a Cost-Efficient Teleoperator for Real-Ready Robot Data
task: LLM agent as cost-efficient teleoperator for robot data collection
key_results: PyRUA-DataFarm generates real-ready robot data at $0.80 per episode; policies trained on farm data match teleoperated baselines (93 vs 84 successes); better robustness under distribution shift (87 vs 46 successes)
comments: Remarkable cost efficiency ($21 one-time per task plus $0.80 per episode vs. $117+ for teleoperation) suggests scalable data generation for robot learning.

inputs: calibration episode of robot in target scene
outputs: synchronized multi-view video with action labels

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLM-generated synthetic data can substitute for teleoperated data with comparable policy performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; farm data policies match teleoperated baselines with better distribution shift robustness

title: StreamDuo: A Live Commentator and a Research Agent for Unseen Games
task: Cross-game streaming video commentary with wiki-augmented research agent
key_results: StreamDuo raises entity recall from 0.082 to 0.116 over Proact-VL; reduces source-game leakage from 9.9% to 1.0% on 10 unseen games
comments: The two-stage training (information-gain labels + on-policy self-distillation) elegantly teaches when to ask for information and how to use noisy wiki answers.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Current commentators transfer timing but not world knowledge when tested cross-game
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; knowledge transfer improves with wiki-augmented research agent

title: Solv3R: 3D Looped Transformer as a Multi-view Solver
task: Multi-view geometry refinement with looped transformers
key_results: Solv3R learns update operator independent of iteration count; supports offline/incremental/streaming reconstruction without task-specific training; achieves efficient key-value caching
comments: The iteration-independent update operator elegantly enables both refinement of fixed collections and integration of new observations within one framework.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A learned iteration-independent update operator can refine and correct multi-view geometry reconstructions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; supports offline, incremental, and streaming tasks without retraining

title: Human-to-Robot Transfer via Bridging Representation and Action Space in VLAs
task: Human-to-robot embodiment adaptation for VLA policies
key_results: H2RB improves object transfer from 8.0% to 51.8% and enables skill transfer at 62.7% where baselines fail; OOD transfer improves from 6.0% to 45.3%
comments: Geometry-anchored representation alignment combined with decoupled-decoder tokenization effectively bridges the embodiment gap while preserving VLA priors.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Human demonstrations can provide useful behavioral supervision for adapting pretrained robot VLAs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; H2RB enables skill transfer where naive co-training fails

title: VA-TDM: A Unified View for Improving Few-Step Diffusion Models by Velocity Adversarial Distillation
task: Few-step diffusion model distillation via velocity adversarial training
key_results: VA-TDM achieves SOTA 4-step text-to-image/video; practical 1-2 step generation with sharp text and fine details; VA-TDM-H3 outperforms Fast-H3 on MiniMax-H3
comments: Unifying score distillation, Fisher matching, and moment matching under VAD framework provides theoretical grounding while enabling practical few-step generation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Velocity field adversarial criticism enables few-step diffusion matching that unifies existing distillation methods
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves SOTA 1-4 step performance across multiple backbones

title: MUON-RT Reusing the Teacher's Trajectory for Momentum-Free Muon for LLM Self-Distillation
task: Memory-efficient optimizer for LLM self-distillation without momentum buffers
key_results: Muon-RT improves accuracy over AdamW by 2.6 points (SDFT) and 2.0 points (SDPO) with 42% less persistent memory; outperforms momentum Muon by 5.4 points with 27% less memory
comments: Reusing teacher-student displacement to eliminate momentum buffers is elegant and theoretically justified through exponentially-weighted history analysis.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Teacher-student displacement encodes exponentially weighted history sufficient to replace momentum buffers
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves linear contraction under regularity and alignment assumptions

title: VideoMemBench: How Well Do MLLMs Remember in Video Conversations?
task: In-context video memory evaluation for multi-turn MLLM conversations
key_results: VideoMemBench: 326 videos with 2,476 turns (1,387 with dependencies); best performer Claude Opus achieves 45.7% overall; reveals in-context video memory is unsolved
comments: Carefully constructed dependencies (episodic and answer-based) with necessity/non-leakage verification expose a genuine gap in current MLLM capabilities.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Current MLLMs can sustain in-context video memory across multi-turn dialogue
hypotheses.result: Rejected; best performance only 45.7%, indicating memory is a bottleneck

title: AnchorComplete: Recovering Complete Scene Meshes from Partial Point Clouds
task: Complete scene mesh reconstruction from partial point clouds
key_results: AnchorComplete outperforms baselines in complete-scene reconstruction; particularly strong under sparse-view settings
comments: Combining partial-point conditioning with metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation elegantly preserves observed geometry while hallucinating plausible unobserved regions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation maintains global structure while hallucinating unobserved geometry
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms baselines particularly under sparse views

title: SpecOPD: Branch-Parallel On-Policy Distillation for Speculative Decoding
task: Parallel on-policy distillation for speculative decoding with tree-structured supervision
key_results: SpecOPD achieves 41.45% higher mean acceptance length; 16.09× supervised-token throughput over sequential OPD; up to 3.56× generation speedup over autoregressive decoding
comments: Parallelizing draft sampling and target supervision via proposal trees enables efficient on-policy distillation without sequential dependencies.

hypotheses.hypothesis: On-policy supervision can be parallelized across independent branches without inheriting sequential draft-verify dependencies
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves substantial speedup with proposal tree packing

title: TAC-CoT: Tool-Empowered Implicit Chain-of-Thought via Interleaving Explicit Tokens
task: Tool-empowered adaptive implicit chain-of-thought with compact latent reasoning
key_results: TAC-CoT improves accuracy up to 8.8 points; reduces forward passes up to 6.8× while enabling tool-use via explicit tokens
comments: Interleaving compact latent reasoning with explicit tokens for tool calls is a pragmatic design that preserves agentic capability without verbalizing every step.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Implicit latent reasoning combined with explicit tool tokens improves agentic reasoning efficiency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; improves accuracy with 6.8× fewer forward passes

title: VidDub: Replacement-Aware Distillation for Two-Step Video Dubbing
task: Two-step video dubbing with replacement-aware distillation
key_results: Replacement-aware masking improves Sync-C by 0.833 on cross-audio; two-step model maintains lip sync with superior visual quality and identity preservation; catches 99.6% vs 78.4% partial fakes
comments: The key insight—that source mouth reconstruction conflicts with dubbing targets—is simple but crucial, and the two-step distillation enables practical deployment.

outputs: dubbed video with synchronized lip movements

hypotheses.hypothesis: Replacement-aware cross-audio supervision improves lip synchronization accuracy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; masking conflicting source-mouth reconstruction improves Sync-C substantially

title: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers
task: Sub-1 bit KV cache quantization for looped transformers
key_results: LoopVQ at 0.5 bpp outperforms existing methods; at 0.25 bpp retains much BF16 accuracy; nearly halves decode latency at 32K context; 4.3-6.1× throughput increase
comments: Exploiting redundancy along the loop axis for joint quantization of multiple loop steps is elegant and achieves impressive compression with minimal accuracy loss.

inputs: KV cache from multiple loop steps

hypotheses.hypothesis: Looped model KV caches exhibit high redundancy exploitable via joint channel quantization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; codebook fine-tuning preserves output quality at 0.5-0.25 bpp

title: SleuthVLM: Do We Really Need Audio-in-Video for Omni Video Understanding?
task: Omni video understanding without direct audio input via VLM agent
key_results: SleuthVLM achieves 75.0% on omni benchmarks (2.6 points above Gemini 3.8 Flash); 77.8% on Video-MME-v2 leaderboard; beats all open-source omni models
comments: The finding that hearing is not the bottleneck but rather agentic ability challenges assumptions driving omni model scaling toward modality alignment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Omni video understanding requires direct audio input in models
hypotheses.result: Rejected; VLM agents with transcribed speech outperform omni models; agentic ability > modality alignment

title: PyRUA-REAL: Robot Exploration and Adaptive Learning through RSI in the Real World
task: Embodied recursive self-improvement through real-world exploration and code refinement
key_results: PyRUA-REAL: 91.1% average success on 8 real-world tasks; 84.4% on 42 RoboDojo benchmark tasks; agents acquire persistent reusable skills from physical interaction
comments: Retaining experience as persistent memory and reusable executable skills enables lasting capability improvements from real-world embodied interaction.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coding agents can improve robot capabilities through recursive self-improvement using physical interaction experience
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves 91.1% success with persistent executable skills

title: How I Aligned Your Model: Scaling Up Multilingual Safety Training with Templates
task: Multilingual safety alignment with template-based augmentation
key_results: MSafeTemp: validated corpus spanning 60 languages; English-only evaluation misjudges multilingual safety; template-based augmentation improves alignment diversity and quality
comments: Demonstrates that translation alone misses culturally-localized failures and that template-based augmentation with authentic entities improves alignment at scale.

outputs: multilingual refusal and benign training data

hypotheses.hypothesis: English-only safety evaluation sufficiently evaluates multilingual safety
hypotheses.result: Rejected; attacks failing in English succeed when translated or culturally localized

title: VeriSpoof: Beyond Real or Fake with One Audio LLM
task: Speech deepfake detection and forensic analysis via audio language model
key_results: VeriSpoof-Plus: 2.14% pooled EER (3rd of 28); VeriSpoof-Base: 4.43% EER (best open-weight); 6.2% EER on source verification; catches 99.6% partial fakes vs 78.4% one-step
comments: Unifying five forensic tasks with grounded, statement-checkable rationales enables explainable detection and catches partial fakes that one-step classifiers miss.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A unified audio LLM with grounded rationales improves deepfake detection and localization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; rationales enable statement verification and catch partial fakes missed by one-step models

title: Hybrid Computer Use: A Unified Programmatic, Semantic, and Visual Interface for General Agents
task: Unified computer-use interface combining programmatic, semantic, and visual channels
key_results: HCU achieves highest Partial and Binary scores on OSWorld 2.0; all models improve with HCU; different models allocate work across channels differently
comments: The unified interface design revealing channel flexibility is compelling—different models discover different optimal channel allocations suggests future agent design space.

outputs: code action / CLI action / GUI action / accessibility action

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agents benefit from flexible access to programmatic, semantic, and visual interfaces
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; all models improve on OSWorld 2.0; channel allocation varies by model

title: On the Generalization Limitation of On-Policy Distillation for Post-RL Consolidation
task: Understanding generalization limitations in on-policy distillation for capability consolidation
key_results: OPD/MOPD reach 96-102% IND but 2.45-16.25% below base on OOD; compositional OOD remains 18-24% below best teachers; geometry-based patching helps
comments: Reveals a blind spot in (M)OPD: excellent IND performance masks incomplete OOD generalization—crucial finding for practitioners relying on distillation for consolidation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: (M)OPD fully transfers teacher generalization capabilities
hypotheses.result: Rejected; OOD scores remain 2.45-16.25% below base model; teacher capability and data coverage are bottlenecks

title: NitroFusion2: Bringing Adversarial Loss to the Text Stream of Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
task: Adversarial distillation for multimodal diffusion transformers with text-stream discrimination
key_results: NitroFusion2 enables 1-2 step generation at comparable quality; 1-step produces sharp text and fine details; 2-step remains competitive across benchmarks
comments: Exploiting the MMDiT text stream as an adversarial representation is novel—the text stream having read the image while tied to condition enables aspect-cued discrimination.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Text-stream adversarial discrimination enables effective few-step MMDiT distillation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves 1-2 step generation with sharp details and competitive quality

title: Koopman Generative Operators for Efficient Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
task: Efficient probabilistic time-series forecasting via Koopman operators and flow matching
key_results: KGO SOTA on 13/17 ProbTS benchmarks (CRPS) and 16/17 (NMAE); 25× faster inference than iterative generative models via single-step closed-form generation
comments: Single-step generation via closed-form matrix exponential in Koopman space elegantly unifies structured dynamics, expressive uncertainty, and computational efficiency.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Koopman flow matching enables single-step probabilistic forecasting without iterative sampling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves 25× inference speedup while maintaining SOTA accuracy

title: UniRestorer++: Scalable Universal Image Restoration with Multi-Granularity Degradation Modeling
task: Scalable universal image restoration via multi-granularity degradation modeling
key_results: UniRestorer++ shows log-linear PSNR trends with scale; stronger gains on OOD/real-world data than vanilla MoE; SOTA on 50-degradation benchmark; zero-shot generalization
comments: Multi-granularity routing with degradation and granularity estimation elegantly balances specialization and robustness without depending on accurate degradation estimates.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-granularity degradation modeling enables scalable universal restoration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; log-linear scaling trends and strong OOD generalization demonstrated

title: GaussianRenderFormer: Transformer-based Rendering of 3D Gaussian Splats
task: Learning to render 3D Gaussian splats via transformer without rasterizer
key_results: GaussianRenderFormer trained on 26,820 objects renders unseen at 38.08 dB PSNR vs 44.02 dB rasterizer; gap narrows to 1.4 dB with ground-truth Gaussian footprints
comments: Learned rendering as an alternative to rasterization is interesting but currently underperforming; view-decoder bottleneck identified via ablations suggests under-training.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transformers can learn to render 3D Gaussians without a rasterizer
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; model learns but underperforms rasterizer; view-decoder bottleneck identified

title: Microtubule stability modulates Schlemm’s canal cell mechanobiology and outflow facility in glaucoma
task: Determine microtubule stability's role in Schlemm's canal mechanotransduction and aqueous humor outflow
key_results: MT stabilization reduces cellular stiffness and increases transcellular pore formation in glaucomatous SC cells; pharmacological MT stabilization enhances conventional outflow facility in ex vivo mouse eyes
comments: Identifies MT-dependent mechanotransduction as a therapeutic target for glaucoma, bridging cellular biomechanics to organ-level fluid drainage.

model_io.model: Primary SC cell cultures (normal and glaucomatous human)

hypotheses.hypothesis: MT stability is reduced in glaucomatous versus normal SC cells
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; diminished MT stability observed in glaucomatous cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: MT stabilization suppresses GEF-H1-dependent contractility and promotes pore formation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in both normal and glaucomatous SC cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: MT stabilization enhances aqueous humor outflow
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; increased conventional outflow facility in treated ex vivo mouse eyes

title: Pericyte-derived exosomal hexokinase 2 promotes retinal neovascularization via non-metabolic ELK3 upregulation
task: Elucidate non-metabolic role of pericyte-derived exosomal hexokinase 2 in retinal neovascularization
key_results: Hypoxic pericytes release HK2-enriched exosomes; HK2 deletion in pericytes reduced neovascular tuft formation; exosomal HK2 activates mTOR to upregulate ELK3 transcription factor; HK2 deletion/exosome inhibition suppressed ELK3
comments: Reveals a non-canonical HK2 function independent of glycolysis, expanding the repertoire of metabolic enzyme signaling roles in developmental angiogenesis.

model_io.model: Oxygen-induced retinopathy (OIR) mouse model and in vitro pericyte-endothelial coculture

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pericyte HK2 is essential for pathological retinal neovascularization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Hk2 deletion reduces tuft formation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exosomal HK2 functions through a non-metabolic mechanism
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; HK2 acts as signaling protein via mTOR-ELK3 axis

title: Targeting hepatocyte-derived LRG1 with dothiortone alleviates hepatic ischemia–reperfusion injury and remote renal damage via suppressing NETosis
task: Define hepatocyte-derived LRG1 as a mediator of NETosis-driven hepatic and remote renal injury and validate dothiortone as an LRG1 inhibitor
key_results: LRG1 is upregulated in mouse HIRI and patient plasma post-hepatectomy; hepatocyte Lrg1 knockout attenuated liver injury, neutrophil infiltration, NET formation, and apoptosis; LRG1-TGFβR1-SMAD3-PAD4 axis drives NETosis; NETs trigger AIM2-dependent hepatocyte apoptosis and renal tubular damage; dothiortone (LRG1 inhibitor) mitigated HIRI and kidney injury
comments: Elegantly maps the hepatocyte-neutrophil crosstalk axis and identifies a natural product inhibitor, demonstrating potential for multi-organ protection via NET suppression.

model_io.model: Mouse hepatic ischemia-reperfusion and cell-based systems

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hepatocyte-derived LRG1 initiates NETosis via TGFβR1-SMAD3-PAD4
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Lrg1 knockout suppresses this pathway

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dothiortone inhibits LRG1 and protects from HIRI/renal injury
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; dothiortone effectively suppressed NETosis and mitigated organ damage

title: Chemokine and opioid peptide scavenging through constitutive and ligand-induced release of ACKR3-bearing extracellular vesicles
task: Characterize ACKR3 release on extracellular vesicles and its role in chemokine/opioid sequestration
key_results: ACKR3 is released on EVs both constitutively and after ligand stimulation via distinct trafficking mechanisms; EV-associated ACKR3 retains high-affinity binding and attenuates CXCL12 and opioid signaling
comments: Reveals EVs as a previously underappreciated dimension of GPCR-mediated ligand scavenging with potential implications for inflammatory and pain regulation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Basal and ligand-induced EV release employ different trafficking mechanisms
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; basal release requires ubiquitination and RAMP3, ligand-induced relies on membrane recycling

hypotheses.hypothesis: EV-associated ACKR3 can functionally sequester ligands
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; EV-ACKR3 retains high-affinity binding and reduces CXCR4/MOR signaling

title: Tau monomers and fibrils escape microglial clearance via distinct cellular mechanisms
task: Dissect mechanistic pathways by which microglia fail to clear extracellular tau species
key_results: Tau monomers are internalized via LRP1 but recycled back without lysosomal degradation; tau fibrils adhere to surface via HSPG and trigger TLR4-mediated inflammation; APOE variants further reduce clearance
comments: Demonstrates that distinct tau conformers evade clearance through different cellular mechanisms, suggesting no single therapeutic intervention will suffice.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tau monomers and fibrils use the same clearance pathway
hypotheses.result: Rejected; monomers traffic via LRP1-endosomal recycling, fibrils adhere via HSPG-TLR4

hypotheses.hypothesis: Heparin and anti-tau treatments reduce microglial activation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for fibril-mediated activation

title: Positional replication fork instability drives PARP inhibitor cytotoxicity
task: Identify G-quadruplex structures at pericentromeric regions as PARPi-sensitive lesions and define the G4-PARP1-TIMELESS-DDX11 safeguard axis
key_results: ESCO2 loss confers PARPi hypersensitivity independent of HR deficiency; ESCO2 loss promotes G4 accumulation at replication-associated sites, particularly pericentromeric regions; PARP1 engages TIMELESS and DDX11 to mitigate G4 stress; PARPi disrupts this by preventing PARP1-dependent TIMELESS/DDX11 engagement, causing G4 accumulation, DNA damage, and chromosomal instability
comments: Reveals position-specific replication fork lesions as previously underrecognized determinants of PARPi sensitivity, suggesting ESCO2-loss tumors as a tractable synthetic-lethal target.

model_io.model: CRISPR screens, single-molecule imaging, and PARPi-treated cancer cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: ESCO2 loss promotes PARPi hypersensitivity through HR-deficiency
hypotheses.result: Rejected; hypersensitivity is HR-independent

hypotheses.hypothesis: G4-PARP1-TIMELESS-DDX11 axis safeguards replication fork stability at hard-to-replicate loci
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PARP inhibition disrupts this protective response, causing accumulation of lesions and genomic instability

title: Adipose derived small extracellular vesicles improve spermatogenesis and fertility in a mouse model of azoospermia compared with stem cell and combination therapies
task: Compare efficacy of adipose-derived MSCs, MSC-sEVs, and combination therapy in a mouse azoospermia model
key_results: AD-MSC-sEVs showed greatest improvements in spermatogenesis-related gene expression, hormonal profiles, sperm quality, and fertility compared to MSCs or combination; no GFP+ spermatozoa or F1 GFP signal detected
comments: Cell-free sEV therapy outperformed intact MSCs, suggesting exosomal cargo rather than cellular engraftment drives regeneration, though lack of GFP tracing limits lineage-tracing conclusions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combination of MSCs and sEVs provides additive benefit
hypotheses.result: Rejected; sEVs alone outperformed combination under these conditions

hypotheses.hypothesis: AD-MSC-sEVs improve spermatogenesis-related gene expression and sperm quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; greatest efficacy observed

title: Weak electromagnetic field configuration differentially shapes cellular redox and metabolic responses
task: Determine whether weak electromagnetic field configuration (not intensity alone) determines cellular redox and metabolic responses
key_results: Sweep field (SF) induced redox partitioning (increased extracellular H₂O₂, reduced mitochondrial H₂O₂); radiofrequency (RF) increased cytosolic NAD⁺/NADH; full tNMR showed increased mitochondrial ROS; respiratory/glycolytic parameters remained comparable
comments: Field configuration emerges as a key tunable variable in electromagnetic bioeffects, though functional consequences of these distinct redox signatures remain to be determined.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Field intensity alone determines cellular response
hypotheses.result: Rejected; field configuration produces distinct redox-metabolic profiles despite similar intensity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Different field configurations induce distinct metabolic phenotypes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SF, RF, and tNMR show non-overlapping redox signatures

title: A tumor-associated K318N variant abolishes AGGF1 nuclear import by disrupting key nucleocytoplasmic transport motifs
task: Identify nuclear import determinants of AGGF1 and characterize tumor-associated K318N variant effects
key_results: K318N variant disrupts importin α1 binding within the 317–328 aa motif, causing cytoplasmic mislocalization and loss of p53 stabilization; RNA-seq reveals enrichment in Rap1 signaling and cytoskeleton genes
comments: Elegant mapping of nucleocytoplasmic transport motifs reveals how a single point mutation can abolish tumor-suppressive function through spatial mislocalization rather than protein instability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: K318 is critical for importin α1 binding
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via GST pull-down; K318N abolishes binding

hypotheses.hypothesis: K318N causes enhanced nuclear export or 14-3-3-dependent sequestration
hypotheses.result: Rejected; mislocalization is independent of these mechanisms

title: MR imaging and spectroscopy reveals metabolic changes in glioblastoma driven by treatment with temozolomide and lonidamine
task: Evaluate metabolic and microstructural effects of lonidamine combined with temozolomide in glioblastoma
key_results: Lonidamine + TMZ significantly reduced lactate and MCT4 expression; early acute mitochondrial respiration decrease with partial recovery; modest survival benefit with no significant volume/DWI differences at day 6
comments: Demonstrates that early metabolic biomarkers are detectable by MRS but long-term efficacy remains unclear; optimization of timing and dosing may be necessary.

model_io.model: GL261 glioblastoma syngeneic model and in vitro culture

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lonidamine reduces glycolytic lactate production in GBM
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; significant lactate decrease and MCT4 downregulation in LND-treated tumors

hypotheses.hypothesis: LND + TMZ combination significantly improves survival over monotherapy
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; enhanced survival observed but not statistically significant at early timepoint

title: Lactylation couples glycolysis with cell cycle progression in cancer cells
task: Characterize lactate-dependent lactylation of PGK1 as a metabolic signal coupling glycolysis to mitotic progression
key_results: Lactate promotes KAT2A-mediated PGK1 K131 lactylation; lactylated PGK1 phosphorylates Aurora B at T232 driving cell cycle progression; PGK1 K131R or Aurora B-binding mutant causes mitotic defects and cGAS-STING activation; PGK1-Aurora B disruptor + anti-PD-1 synergizes anti-tumor immunity
comments: Elegantly demonstrates how a metabolic byproduct directly couples glycolytic flux to cell cycle machinery through protein post-translational modification, with immunological implications.

model_io.model: Cancer cell lines and mouse tumor models
inputs: PGK1 variants (WT, K131R, Aurora B-binding defective)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Glycolytic lactate directly regulates mitotic progression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; lactate-driven PGK1 lactylation phosphorylates and activates Aurora B

hypotheses.hypothesis: Disrupting PGK1-Aurora B interaction suppresses tumor growth
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; single-agent and synergistic anti-tumor effects observed

title: Energy-guided combinatorial co-optimization of antibody affinity and stability
task: Optimize antibody affinity and stability via energy-guided combinatorial mutagenesis
key_results: Combinatorial library of 7000 variants achieved up to 30-fold affinity gain while co-optimizing stability; 10-design screening improved affinity by order-of-magnitude; diverse high-mutational-load variants favored over single solution
comments: Strong protein engineering result but limited to computational/in vitro validation; actual therapeutic potential requires in vivo confirmation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Energy-based combinatorial optimization enables simultaneous affinity and stability gains without convergence to single solution
hypotheses.result: Library converged on diverse variants with high mutational load and up to 30-fold affinity improvement

title: An information-theoretic framework for inferring T cell dynamics from single-cell RNA and T cell receptor sequencing
task: Infer joint clonotype-phenotype distributions from paired single-cell TCR and transcriptomic data using hierarchical Bayesian framework
key_results: TCRi applied to 167,118 CD8 T cells from anti-PD-(L)1 treated cancer patients; mutual information emerged as robust discriminator of therapeutic response; computed information-theoretic quantities: clonotypic entropy, phenotypic entropy, phenotypic flux, mutual information
comments: Novel information-theoretic approach to clonal-phenotypic coupling, but limited to one outcome (therapeutic response); mechanism underlying mutual information's predictive power not explored.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Information-theoretic quantities (entropy, mutual information) characterize clonotype-phenotype relationships and predict immunotherapy response
hypotheses.result: Mutual information emerged as robust discriminator of anti-PD-(L)1 response

title: Multiscale multimodal integration of spatial omics through a deep generative model with CORAL
task: Integrate spatial omics across modalities and scales using deep generative model with graph attention
key_results: CORAL unified high-resolution limited-coverage and low-resolution genome-wide datasets; accurately identified spatial domains, predicted high-resolution molecular profiles, detected spatially variable genes, inferred cell-cell interactions; HCC immunotherapy application revealed organized immune-cell subsets and therapeutic-resistance signaling
comments: Innovative multi-modal integration leveraging graph learning, but evaluation on synthetic/experimental datasets; clinical predictive utility for immunotherapy response requires prospective validation.

comments: Novel platform combining ferromagnetism and superconductivity, but mechanisms underlying nonreciprocity (edge channels vs. ferromagnetism) remain ambiguous.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ferromagnetism breaks time-reversal symmetry in Josephson junction, producing unconventional Fraunhofer patterns
hypotheses.result: Supported; hysteresis, flux jumps, and nonreciprocity observed

title: Insect-inspired hexapod robot with magnetically coupled compliant and modular drive system
task: Insect-inspired hexapod robot with magnetically coupled modular drive
key_results: Cost of transport 30; >90% autonomous recovery under vertical perturbations; tool-free leg replacement and reconfiguration
comments: Elegant bio-inspired design with practical modularity; magnetic transmission adds mechanical adaptability but may limit force transmission limits.

model_io.model: INSECTRON hexapod with magnetic micro-clutches and Hall sensors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Magnetic clutch transmission provides intrinsic mechanical adaptability analogous to biological preflex
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; robust recovery and damage tolerance demonstrated

title: Single-particle limit of a topological edge state in a locally resonant band gap
task: Single-particle mode formation in SSH topological metamaterial with local resonator
key_results: Inverse participation ratio exactly unity (single-particle limit); extreme localization at low frequencies below first Bragg gap; disorder-robust boundary stabilization
comments: Elegant combination of topology and resonance; practical 1D device implementation feasible but higher-dimensional extensions unclear.

model_io.model: 1D SSH-inspired stiffness dimer with local resonator

hypotheses.hypothesis: Topological edge state collapse onto attenuation singularity produces single-particle mode with unity participation ratio
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SPM achievable by tuning dimerization to migrate singularity into band gap

title: Chimney-board metastructures for birefraction and asymmetric transmission of water waves
task: Birefraction and asymmetric transmission of water waves via chimney-board metastructure
key_results: Effective refractive index difference 1.55; refraction separation angle >40°; broadband operation with diffraction-free high-order transmission
comments: First demonstration of water-wave birefraction; practical harbor protection application shown but limited by low-frequency constraint.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stratified chimney-board geometry creates double modes enabling birefraction in water waves
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 40° separation and 1.55 index difference achieved experimentally

hypotheses.hypothesis: Asymmetric transmission can block destructive ocean waves while allowing harbor escape
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated in proof-of-concept; practical coastal protection application viable
